body:
## Executive summary

PR #6 is the corrective v0.1 foundation for AIP's bounded cognitive core. It is now technically reviewed and ready to merge as a foundation. It still does not claim that Phases 8–13 are functional; the gap matrix records the missing engineering and those phases continue as separate substantial PRs.

## Corrective changes

- `bf6d332` fixes Windows Rust/Tauri test startup (`STATUS_ENTRYPOINT_NOT_FOUND (0xc0000139)`) with a scoped MSVC test manifest/build configuration.
- `8a3b193` stabilizes the five failures exposed after startup recovery: forward migration 0021, legacy capability parsing, fixture ownership/FK setup, and companion internal-vs-external device ID handling.
- `71ae308` adds `docs/CORRECTIVE_GAP_MATRIX.md`, comparing roadmap claims, actual behavior, missing engineering, validation, and status classification.

## Verified evidence

- Remote CI run 48 (`32391697619`) for head `bf6d332b92f58fb59cd7ec7b909b271750798f5f`: `phase-zero` passed, including Rust/Tauri tests; `package` passed, including exact-SHA NSIS/MSI build and upload.
- Remote Windows artifact `aip-windows-b22490b582f0695ed058e64d76348391c4e1c175` digest: `sha256:50af7c8d98f4ffd718eab978e6a2ba6c7cc9b36ade7a4e540905d8c6418a9ca2`.
- Local `pnpm tauri:check`: Rust fmt/check/clippy plus 113 library tests passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored only for the optional local Ollama model.
- Local `scripts/build-runtime.ps1`: sidecar smoke passed; `aip-runtime.exe` SHA-256 `052E3BE00C97A7FBB05B346C17D4F3F792E006BE432C64796ED11A860FBF05E7`.
- Local `pnpm --filter @aip/desktop tauri build`: release build passed and produced NSIS and MSI bundles.
- Local `pnpm secrets:scan`: 146 repository files checked, passed.
- Codex Security diff scan `17664803-14f1-4d28-a19f-169320799adf` for `c59e144..bf6d332`: complete coverage, zero findings; TAC display was unavailable.
- Biel4 App Server reviewer bounded corrective pass: `approved`, zero findings, read-only provenance.

## Truthful phase status

- Phases 0–6 and 7A: APPROVED baseline as previously reviewed.
- Phases 7B–7F: FOUNDATION ONLY pending later independent phase review.
- Phase 8: FOUNDATION ONLY; synthetic metadata exists, but real local audio/STT/TTS/wake/custom voice is not implemented.
- Phase 9: FOUNDATION ONLY; manifests/fixtures exist, but real root-scoped supervised effects and provider-neutral adapters are not implemented.
- Phase 10: FOUNDATION ONLY; catalog/lifecycle metadata exists, but no sandboxed extension execution exists.
- Phase 11: FOUNDATION ONLY; synthetic visual contracts exist, but no Windows capture/visual adapter exists.
- Phase 12: MISSING; no real Android project/APK or authenticated desktop transport exists.
- Phase 13: MISSING; no real AIP-side authenticated socket gateway exists.

## Boundaries

AIP remains standalone. No BielOS import, telemetry, public listener, secrets/private data, force push/reset/rebase, or weakened safety gate was added. Rust/SQLite remain authoritative; ownership, bounded payloads, replay/idempotency, audit, safe-mode and temporary-chat controls remain fail-closed.

## Acceptance and next work

Architect acceptance: the corrective foundation is accepted for normal merge after CI/package and independent review evidence above. Merge does not imply stable release. Implement Phases 8–13 in separate PRs with real local runtime behavior, deterministic tests, package/APK/gateway evidence, and distinct Architect/Executor/Reviewer provenance.

## Current status

FUNCTIONAL — AUTOMATED VALIDATION COMPLETE for the corrective foundation; future Phase 8–13 work remains FOUNDATION ONLY or MISSING as classified above. Human Owner/manual UX, security/publication ceremony, and stable-release gates remain open.

## Final recommendation

HUMAN_VALIDATION_REQUIRED — merge this reviewed foundation only; continue the roadmap and do not declare a stable release until human, security, publication, and functional-phase gates are complete.
